Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1. Heard Sri Anand Pati Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No. 145 of 2024, registered under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of DP Act, Police Station Phaphund, District Auraiya during pendency of the trial.

3. Allegation in FIR is that deceased marriage was solemnized in the year 2021 with the applicant's son, thereafter, applicant and accused persons torture the deceased for additional demand of dowry and due to non fulfillment of the same, they killed her.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior Lajjawati Alias Shanti vs State Of U.P. on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21232607/
1 motive.

entities.text: Lajjawati Alias Shanti vs State Of U.P. on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased.
Version of FIR itself reveals that allegation of demand of additional dowry is against the husband of the deceased and applicant has no concern with the present case.
Applicant has no previous criminal history.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 26.06.2024.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.

4. Learned A.G.A. as well as informant's counsel have vehemently opposed the bail prayer of the applicant and submitted that deceased died in unnatural circumstances within seven years of marriage, hence, prima facie offence is made out against the applicant, as such, applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.

5. Considering the material available on record and keeping in view the nature of the offence,
argument advanced on behalf of the parties, evidence on record regarding complicity of the accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant, Lajjawati @ Shanti, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 11.9.2024 Nitin Verma  Lajjawati Alias Shanti vs State Of U.P. on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21232607/
